items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: what's his name, Kaempfert? He has a nice band, and, gees, he plays a whole chorus with his trumpet, and it's just nice

ctx.x: And then maybe another one, and it would still be different. Now, all these things have been -- have been piled up, got together, collected, and they've been published as different takes of what he had done, and they're all

acceptable. With a guy -- a guy with talent like that would have -- oh, he would have been quite a ways ahead, and I don't think he ever would have gone in for anything high note, or -- maybe he wouldn't have got very far, but also recently you heard -- there's -- what's his name, Kaempfert? He has a nice band, and, gees, he plays a whole chorus with his trumpet, and it's just nice -- a little off the melody here and there. And it's pleasant.
You may not like that. I don't think you would. But there are any number of people, because his records sell. And he keeps making more -- it's commercial.
